commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.

73' Here comes a substitution. Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) is brought on as a substitute for Brenden Aaronson.

45+1' A nice lofted cross finds Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the bottom right post, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save!
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

44' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Karl Darlow pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

43' Great solo effort by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.

38' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
36' Leeds are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
34' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) is flagged for offside.

26' 60:40 – the ratio of ball possession.
